entities.summary: Guðmundur Ívarsson Guðmundsson was an Icelandic politician and former minister. He was the Minister of Finance of Iceland from 1958 to 1959. He was also a diplomat who served as ambassador to the United Kingdom, to Spain and Portugal, to Nigeria (1971), to the United States, to Sweden and to Belgium, Luxembourg, the European Union and NATO (1977-1979).

entities.summary: Guðmundur Ívarsson Guðmundsson was an Icelandic politician and former minister. He was the Minister of Finance of Iceland from 1958 to 1959. He was also a diplomat who served as ambassador to the United Kingdom, to Spain and Portugal, to Nigeria (1971), to the United States, to Sweden and to Belgium, Luxembourg, the European Union and NATO (1977-1979).
